Who are the authors of 'NFDI4DS Gateway.sparql:
#ASK-DBLP: Who are the authors of 'NFDI4DS Gateway and Portal.'?
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
SELECT ?author ?author_name WHERE {
  ?publication dblp:title ?title .
  FILTER CONTAINS(?title, "NFDI4DS Gateway and Portal") .
  ?publication dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  ?author dblp:creatorName ?author_name .
}

Question Answering papers published in I.sparql:
#ASK-DBLP: Question Answering papers published in ISWC.
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?title WHERE {
  ?paper dblp:title ?title .
  ?paper dblp:publishedInStream ?stream .
  ?stream dblp:primaryStreamTitle ?stream_title .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?stream_title, "ISWC"))
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?title, "Question Answering"))
}

What is the highly cited paper from ISWC.sparql:
# ASK-DBLP: What is the highly cited paper from ISWC?
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?title (COUNT(?citation) as ?cites) WHERE {
  ?paper dblp:publishedInStream <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/iswc> .
  ?paper dblp:title ?title .
  ?paper dblp:omid ?omid .
  ?citation cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid .
}
GROUP BY ?paper ?title
ORDER BY DESC(?cites)
LIMIT 1
